title: Base Read Holding Registers variant 6
purpose: Provide a structurally distinct multi-message transaction with a multi-register Read Holding Registers request and a matching normal response payload.

messages.label: Holding-register transaction setup request, unit 19, start address 0, quantity 8
Read Holding Registers response, unit 19, 8 registers

expected_behavior: The server should associate both frames by transaction identifier 0003 and interpret the operation as reading eight holding registers, with a response byte count of 16 and eight two-byte register values.
constraints_preserved: Protocol identifier is 0000 in both directions.
Request MBAP length 0006 is correct for the unit and five-byte request PDU.
Response MBAP length 0013 equals one unit byte plus one function byte, one byte count, and 16 data bytes.
Response transaction identifier and unit identifier match the request.
Function code 03 and quantity 0008 are complete and consistent with the response byte count.
Hex is lowercase and contains no separators.
issue_safety_notes: No vulnerability issue knowledge is available; the two-frame exchange is a conservative structural seed based on model-internal protocol knowledge only.
